mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 signals robust demand growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not show sustained quarterly increase over the past 3 months, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 4.6% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.6% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 4.6% or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS (easing) combined with elevated GDPC1 (demand) creates a dual signal of accommodative policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth > 5% over the past quarter
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS does not fall below 1% or GDPC1 growth does not exceed 5% in the past quarter, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% signals monetary normalization, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not fall below 1% in the next quarter, or returns over 60 days are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO above 105 signals robust supply growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise above 105 over the next month, or returns over 5 days are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS crossing above 150,000 in the next month triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 150,000 in the next month
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not cross above 150,000 or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: High HOUST (demand) combined with low FEDFUNDS (easing) creates a dual signal of robust demand and accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Either HOUST does not exceed 1300 or FEDFUNDS does not fall below 1%, or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) combined with elevated INDPRO (supply) signals inflationary supply growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by >1% and INDPRO rises above 105 in the next month
failure_condition: Either CPIAUCSL does not rise by >1% or INDPRO does not exceed 105, or returns over 60 days are not positive.
